activity_summary: Leaving the Bear, you named thirty-six miles to High Wycombe and decided not to bait at Oxford. You did not name a price for the bed or the provender.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Chose the through ride, and did not price the night behind him.

facets.activity: Left the Bear and set the ride through Oxford

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not bait at Oxford.
